title: Radiology lab PC still runs cleartext Telnet
remediation: Replace vendor Telnet management interface with SSH or vendor-supported HTTPS console; scheduled for the next maintenance window because the imaging vendor must certify the change first.

title: Guest Wi-Fi VLAN can still reach the billing database subnet
remediation: Blocked by the default-deny forward chain rendered in T4; retained here for audit trail continuity from the pre-project state.

title: SNMP agent answers v1/v2c community-string queries
remediation: Migrate to SNMPv3 with authPriv; community string "public" must be retired once the monitoring team finishes onboarding v3 credentials.

title: Billing admin panel served over cleartext HTTP
remediation: Terminate TLS in front of the admin vhost and redirect port 80 to 443; certificate request is filed with IT.

title: No egress filtering yet validated for DNS tunneling on the medical device VLAN
remediation: Custom Suricata rule (T10) now detects long-label DNS queries in offline replay; live inline enforcement is out of scope for this module.

title: Windows Firewall alignment not yet verified on all domain-joined workstations
remediation: 6-windows_firewall.ps1 has been validated on a pilot group of 5 workstations; fleet-wide GPO rollout is scheduled after change approval.
